liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls this Sugaree great; Reviewer names this Sugaree the standout of the show [21][22][27]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): The crowd roared when Vince played his first notes of Stranger [25]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (1 review): Sound cut out completely during this song, then returned, revealing how loud the band was on the floor [19]
- **New Speedway Boogie** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry sounds good here, with Melvin Seals meshing well with him [30]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-03-29.4MicMixBaker.109110.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 160 min [1]
- **gd1991-03-29.149579.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd1991-03-29.146568.neuman-skm150.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 161 min [7]. Said about its sound: Intermittent wind noise in set two, mostly removed [7]
- **gd91-03-29.sbd.wiley.8232.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 157 min; rated 3.3/5 by 10 [10]. Said about its sound: Recording sounds very good, though the reviewer found the second set's playing weaker; Reviewer finds the recording sounds excellent, better than the tape copy they had in college; Soundboard has excessive Wince in the right channel; reviewer wants a front-of-board version [20][21][22]

## Around the show

- A PA outage hit the floor during Masterpiece, forcing a shortened first set; the sound returned at overwhelming volume [19]
- PA problems ended the first set after Masterpiece; Hornsby did not sit in during this run [20]
- The right PA tower shorted out during Masterpiece while the reviewer was on the floor [22]
- Reviewer's first Dead show, after driving from Toronto; the parking-lot scene fascinated them. A veteran friend dozed during set two [24]
- Reserved seat close to the stage; band members smiled, but rain water leaking in caused technical difficulties [25]
- Speakers exploded during the show; reviewer attended all three nights of the run [26]
- Jerry can be heard afterwards remarking that the show had a little life to it [27]
- PA problems during Masterpiece forced the first set to end [1]
- Reviewer felt shorted a Bird Song in set one; a friend said set would have ended with the New Speedway played in set two [19]
- Reviewer, a fan of 1970s shows, felt this sounded like a different band [24]
- Reviewer compares the Sugaree to the Lake Placid one, which they call the best [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-03-29.4MicMixBaker.109110.flac16**: taped by Baker; source: Master Audience Four Mic Mix Nakamichi CM300's/CP4 Sotguns And Sennheiser 441's> unknown Mixer>Sony D-6>--# Patch out of ?--- Tapes:Maxell MX-S 100's [1]. Also: Four-mic mix transferred by Baker from a taper's tapes; the lead deck taper's masters are still awaited [1]
- **gd1991-03-29.149579.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Master Digital FOB Recording by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick; transferred by Transfer by Charlie Miller Edited & Mastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel March 19, 2020; source: Recording: Schoeps CMC3 MK4’s (110°) > Panasonic SV-255 (16/48) Location: FOB mics hand held, section B1, row 19, seat 8 [6]
- **gd1991-03-29.146568.neuman-skm150.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: Source: (FOB) Neuman SKM150 (90 Deg X-Y) > Oade p/s > Panasonic SV255 > DAT (48K) - Taped by Tim Dalton [7]
- **gd91-03-29.sbd.wiley.8232.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> Cassette> DAT> Tascam DA-20 MKII> Delta Dio 2496> Cool Edit> CDR [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1991-03-29 Fri Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum, Uniondale, NY](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1252940613889/grateful-dead-1991-03-29-fri-nassau) [32]
- Fan art by Robbi Cohn: [1991-03-29 Nassau Coliseum, Uniondale, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-03-29-nassau-coliseum-uniondale-ny-usa/) [33]
